description.title: Adira Silver - הרחבות לפרק הדירה
description.summary: This table details extensions to the apartment insurance chapter under the Adira Silver policy. It specifies coverage for plants, lawns, irrigation systems, and storerooms, limited to fire, lightning, and explosion risks.
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת הרחבות לפרק הדירה בפוליסת אדירה כסף. ההרחבות כוללות כיסוי לנזקים לצמחייה, מדשאות, מערכות השקיה, ומחסנים שאינם צמודים לדירה. הכיסוי מוגבל לנזקים כתוצאה משריפה, ברק ופיצוץ, ואחריות המבטח לא תעלה על 2% מסכום הביטוח בפרק א' - ביטוח דירה. הפוליסה Adira Silver מציעה הרחבות לכיסוי צמחייה, מדשאות, מחסנים, פרגולות, חניות, וכיסויים אחרים. ההרחבה לגבי צמחייה, מדשאות, עצים ושיחים חלה על רכוש השייך לדירה. הרחבה לגבי מחסן שאינו צמוד לדירה כוללת גם פרגולות, חניות וכיסויים אחרים שאינם מחוברים באופן קבוע.

sketch:
6. Adira Silver extensions to the Apartment Chapter
6.1 Extension in regard to plants, lawns and irrigation systems The insurance is extended to cover damage to plants, lawns, trees, shrubs and
irrigation systems belonging to the apartment.
6.2 Extension in regard to a storeroom and non-fixed parts insured's premises, which are not permanent parts of the apartment and/or are
The insurance is extended to cover a storeroom which is not adjacent to the apartment, any pergola, awning, roofing and shading accessories on the not permanently affixed thereto.
An insured event relating to paragraphs 6.1 and 6.2 is limited to loss or damage caused as a result of fire, lightning and explosion risks only and the insurer's liability in regard to these paragraphs shall not exceed 2% of the sum insured under Chapter A - Apartment Insurance.

This table details extensions to the apartment insurance chapter under the Adira Silver policy. It specifies coverage for plants, lawns, irrigation systems, and storerooms, limited to fire, lightning, and explosion risks.

6. Adira Silver extensions to the Apartment Chapter
6.1 Extension in regard to plants, lawns and irrigation systems The insurance is extended to cover damage to plants, lawns, trees, shrubs and
irrigation systems belonging to the apartment.
6.2 Extension in regard to a storeroom and non-fixed parts insured's premises, which are not permanent parts of the apartment and/or are
The insurance is extended to cover a storeroom which is not adjacent to the apartment, any pergola, awning, roofing and shading accessories on the not permanently affixed thereto.
An insured event relating to paragraphs 6.1 and 6.2 is limited to loss or damage caused as a result of fire, lightning and explosion risks only and the insurer's liability in regard to these paragraphs shall not exceed 2% of the sum insured under Chapter A - Apartment Insurance.
